# Tabs

## Purpose and role

A strip of tabs, one selected; tabs may close and a `+` may add one.

Role: `tablist`.

## Keyboard

| Key (Desktop) | Key (Vim) | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `←→` | `←→` | Switch tab |
| `x` `Delete` | `x` `Delete` | Close tab |
| `n` | `n` | New tab |
| `↓` | `↓` | Show hidden |
| `1` `2` `3` `4` `5` `6` `7` `8` `9` | `1` `2` `3` `4` `5` `6` `7` `8` `9` | Jump to tab |

## Mouse

| Target | Click | Double click | Secondary click | Drag | Wheel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| tab | selects it | — | opens its menu | — | — |
| close button | closes the tab | — | — | — | — |

## Hints by state

| State | Desktop | Vim |
|---|---|---|
| focused | `←→` Switch tab | `←→` Switch tab |

## Knobs

| Knob | Default | Layer | Standard |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nav` | the NavProfile's keys (Desktop: arrows, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End) | profile | APG keyboard interaction |
| `keymap` | the command enum's `default_keymap()` | key map | WCAG 2.1.4 (remappable) |

## Keyboard-only path

- Switch tab: `←→`
- Close tab: `x` `Delete`
- New tab: `n`
- Show hidden: `↓`
- Jump to tab: `1` `2` `3` `4` `5` `6` `7` `8` `9`

## Mouse-first path

- tab: click selects it; double click —; wheel —.
- close button: click closes the tab; double click —; wheel —.
